correctness.reason: Roles come from the .claude/agents frontmatter with catalog enabled/remote overrides; grid is no longer read. Every enabled local role runs claudeteam.sh --team-pane <mode> --agent <role> --name <session>, which writes <state>/<session>.pid before anything else (exec keeps the PID), applies session_env (lead all+lead, roles all with the lead names unset, remote role remote), adds --effort from the frontmatter unless given and --teammate-mode tmux for the lead, and expands the kickoff (all spec placeholders incl. {task_list}). The remote pane runs the ssh loop only (no local claude); the server command carries --effort, -e session_env.remote and CLAUDE_AGENTS_SESSION=1. The --name token test cannot be fooled by the pane's bash -lc string, the tmux server argv or the ssh argument (each is one token). Idle panes (claude exited, pane back to bash -l) are respawned in place. --status stays read-only (CCI_CHECK_ONLY, no provisioning, tmux plan lines only). The regrid uses resize-pane only, so the after-select-layout hook cannot loop.

layout plans 1K/2K/4K.reason: Recomputed by hand from claude_team_pack/claude_team_tab_grid with the catalog (21 enabled non-lead roles + lead; pycore-gpu-remote disabled). 213x52: 4 tabs, lead 106x51 + 3 roles 106x16, then 6 roles 70-71x24, 9 roles 70-71x16, 3 roles 70x51. 227x57: 3 tabs, lead 100x56 + 5 roles 62-63x18, then 8 and 8 roles 75x18/27. 284x72: 2 tabs, lead 100x71 + 3x3 roles 60-61x23, then 4x3 roles 70-71x23. Lead >= 100x30 and roles >= 60x15 everywhere; every enabled role is placed exactly once; laravel-remote appears only as its ssh-loop pane. The first lead split at 227 cols floors to a 99-col lead until the final synchronous regrid restores 100 (harmless).

one lead at a time.reason: claude_team_scan_live (:904-942) only warns when the other socket holds core-node-team. ca-orchestrator and ct-orchestrator have different names and PID files, so neither check sees the other lead and two agent-teams leads share the task list core-node-team.
